name: OpenWrt Wi-Fi Device History v0.2.3.2
description: Homarr-safe Wi-Fi history: no array map/slice/join calls.
template:
<Stack gap="sm">
<Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>OpenWrt Wi-Fi Device History</Text><Group gap="xs"><RefreshButton requestId="snapshot" size="xs"/><RefreshButton requestId="history" size="xs"/></Group></Group>
{status.snapshot?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red">Wi-Fi snapshot request failed: check /wifi in Data tab.</Alert> : null}
{status.history?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red">History request failed: check /wifi/history in Data tab and request settings.</Alert> : null}
{!data.history ? <Text size="sm">Wi-Fi history not available.</Text> : <SimpleGrid cols={3} spacing="xs"><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Known MACs</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">{data.history.totalKnown ?? 0}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Online</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">{data.history.online ?? 0}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Offline</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">{data.history.offline ?? 0}</Text></Paper></SimpleGrid>}
{data.snapshot?.errors?.length ? <Alert color="orange">OpenWrt polling errors. Check /wifi JSON.</Alert> : null}
<Text fw={600} size="sm">Recent device events · 24h</Text>
{!data.history?.events?.length ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">No events recorded yet.</Text> : null}
